CustomField.description: When true, ramp phases use independent quantities (each phase = total at that point, not split from a total). Used for Cage and HyperScale products where Phase 1=25, Phase 2=100, Phase 3=300 means 300 total, not 25+100+300.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check for products where ramp phase quantities represent cumulative totals (e.g. Cage, HyperScale) rather than splits from a base quantity.
CustomField.label: Aggregate Ramp Qty
